name: yacht

scripts.optimize-hands: gltf-transform optimize assets/hands_model_rigged.glb public/assets/fpv/hands.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false
scripts.optimize-weapons: gltf-transform optimize assets/revolver.glb public/assets/fpv/revolver.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false && gltf-transform optimize assets/spanish_rapier.glb public/assets/fpv/rapier.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false && gltf-transform optimize assets/skull_lantern.glb public/assets/fpv/skull_lantern.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false && gltf-transform metalrough assets/flintlock_colonial_pistol_2019__free.glb /tmp/flintlock-mr.glb && gltf-transform optimize /tmp/flintlock-mr.glb public/assets/fpv/flintlock.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false && gltf-transform optimize assets/metal_hanging_lantern.glb public/assets/fpv/candle_lantern.glb --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --compress meshopt --flatten false --join false --prune false
